courseFrameworkRefs.label: Candidate Kindergarten Operations and Algebraic Thinking scope

evidenceGroups.title: Represent addition in multiple ways
evidenceGroups.officialTextSnapshot: Represent addition and subtraction with objects, fingers, mental images, drawings, sounds, acting out situations, verbal explanations, expressions, or equations.
evidenceGroups.claimBoundary: Partial evidence: Chapter 1 represents addition with objects, fingers, drawings, acting out, expressions, and equations, but contains no subtraction evidence.

evidenceGroups.title: Solve addition problems within 10
evidenceGroups.officialTextSnapshot: Solve addition and subtraction word problems, and add and subtract within 10, using objects or drawings to represent the problem.
evidenceGroups.claimBoundary: Partial evidence: Chapter 1 solves addition problems with totals through 9 using visual models, but contains no subtraction problems or assessments.
